# LocalShare

> LocalShare is a native macOS app for sharing files and text to browsers on the same network, with optional read-only remote access through a self-hosted LocalShare Server.

The macOS Client serves selected content directly. In remote mode, the Client opens an authenticated WebSocket to LocalShare Server; the Server relays requests and streams without storing shared files.

## User documentation

- [Documentation overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/index.md): Product overview and local versus remote sharing model.
- [Client quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/client/getting-started.md): Install and start a local share.
- [File sharing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/client/file-sharing.md): File, folder, preview, upload, and access-boundary behavior.
- [Text transfer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/client/text-transfer.md): Bidirectional text transfer on the local network.
- [Server overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/index.md): Server responsibilities and remote request path.
- [Server deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/deployment.md): Binary installation, TLS, systemd, and management commands.
- [Connect Client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/connect-client.md): Pair a Client and publish a remote read-only share.

## Agent workflows

- [Deploy with Codex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/codex-deploy.md): Copyable prompt and Skill installation guidance.
- [LocalShare Server deployment Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/.agents/skills/localshare-server-deploy/SKILL.md): Reusable instructions for installing and validating LocalShare Server on Linux.
